d:
Join Arti Chhawari as she travels to Patna, Bihar, to experience CHHATH PUJA — the world’s biggest and most heartfelt festival dedicated to the Sun God (Surya Dev) and Chhathi Maiya.
From the sacred ritual of Kharna to the grand Sandhya Arghya (evening offerings) and the emotional Usha Arghya (sunrise prayers), witness how millions of devotees celebrate four days of fasting, faith, and family togetherness.
In this video:
Real-life visuals from Patna’s Chhath Ghats & villages
Making of the sacred khir and thekua (holy delicacies)
Families fasting 36 hours without water — out of pure devotion
